transcript: On Tuesday the upload API returned errors for twelve minutes. Redis was healthy. The cause was a full uploads volume. The team removed abandoned temporary files and service recovered. No customer files were lost. The follow-up is to alert at eighty percent disk usage.
required_facts: full uploads volume was the cause

transcript: We compared two transcription models on the same twenty clips. Model A had a word error rate of eight percent and Model B six percent. Model B took twice as long on our CPU. We chose Model A for the interactive service because latency matters more there. We have not tested either model on noisy recordings.
required_facts: B twice as slow on CPU

transcript: The team proposed adding a GPU worker next month. The estimated monthly cost is three hundred dollars, but finance has not approved it. Until approval, the CPU service stays in place. Maya will collect peak-hour queue measurements by Friday. No deployment date has been agreed.
